items.briefing:
New research from Commvault shows one in three Australia and New Zealand organisations are still paying ransomware demands — a costly and risky response that rarely guarantees data recovery. This comes as a NSW Government audit has found major agencies repeatedly failing the same cybersecurity controls year after year, suggesting systemic gaps that aren't being addressed. Both findings are a reminder that Australian organisations, including training providers, need stronger prevention and recovery plans rather than relying on paying attackers.

A separate report also highlights that AI tools are moving quickly and staff should be cautious about what information they share when using them.

**Practical tip:** Never enter student or staff personal information into public AI tools — treat them like a stranger on the street.

featured.title: One in three ANZ organisations still pay ransomware demands, Commvault research says
featured.quote: One in three ANZ organisations still paying ransomware demands represents critical security failure.
